meaning:
ὑβριστής, -οῦ, ὁ
(ὑβρίζω), [in LXX chiefly for גֵּאֶה ;]
a violent, insolent man: Rom.1:20, 1Ti.1:13 (EV, injurious).†
SYN.: ἀλαζών, ὑπερήφανος, see Tr., Syn., § xxix (AS)

elsewhere.note: backbiters, hateful to God, insolent, arrogant, boastful, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,
although I used to be a blasphemer, a persecutor, and insolent. However, I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.
